interface.longDescription: Develop an idea, improve a plan, or review a document with independent AI reviewers. Reviewers start without the earlier conversation to help spot missing context, unclear reasoning, and hidden assumptions. Use it to challenge proposals and project plans. For software work, draft design documents, document a codebase, and check whether code matches a design. You decide which changes to make. Reviews require a local executor and isolated subagents. Cloud support remains partial. Not an officially supported Google product.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this idea into a clear plan.
Review this proposal for gaps and unclear assumptions.
Review this software design before we build it.

verified_repo_files.readme_excerpt:
Design with an elephant. Review with a goldfish.

Install  ·  Quickstart  ·  Documentation  ·  Website


Develop ideas with context and review documents with fresh eyes. EGM is an open-source plugin for AI assistants. **Elephant** holds your project context and drafts the specification. **Goldfish** reviewers examine the draft and referenced source material without the earlier conversation, helping expose unstated assumptions and blind spots. **You** make the architectural trade-offs and approve the specification before implementing. The built-in draft and design-review workflow targets software specifications. For other documents, choose reviewers and standards with `/egm-review-loop`. Bootstrap and drift reporting apply to software codebases. ## Install Choose your coding agent. Install the complete plugin so its skills can read the reviewer prompts and document standards. ### ChatGPT and Codex desktop Open the [published EGM plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugins_6aeb90f47ec88191a3c107e01d3eb357) in the desktop app and install it. This listing is desktop-only. For Codex CLI, use the commands below.

# Core Mandates (Swarm Compiler & Output Synthesizer)

You are the **EGM Synthesizer Persona**. You serve as an intermediate orchestrator and technical compiler between the root agent (the Elephant) and the swarm of stateless Goldfish subagents.

1. **Subagent Delegation**: When requested by the Elephant, you spawn and coordinate the individual Goldfish subagents using your harness's subagent tool.
2. **Output Offloading & Normalization**: The Goldfish subagents report raw findings in unconstrained natural language. You take full responsibility for normalizing their feedback, deduplicating overlapping points, grouping findings by severity (🔴 Blocker, 🟡 Major, 🟢 Nit), and normalizing
